messages:
alice: Noticed a spike in tokenization mismatches in eu-west after we unpinned runtime 3.7.2 -> 3.8.0 last night. Small but persistent, ~0.8% errors on quant models. anyone digging in?

deploy-bot: Unpin event: runtime 3.8.0 -> canary (eu-west) at 1755555540. 15/150 instances reporting.
jun: I see failures in logs: `token_lookup_out_of_range` coming from tokenizer when sequence length > 2048 on llama-q series. Hit on 3.8.0 only.
rachel: pasted a short trace: ```
[2026-02-10T22:25:12Z] ERR tokenizer: index 4096 out of range (vocab_size=4096)
model: llama-q-v3b
runtime: 3.8.0
sdk: 2.9.0
stack: decoder->tokenizer->encoder
```

alice: that's the one. Looks like padding/length calc changed in 3.8.0, maybe our long-seq guard got inverted for quant path. We need containment.

ops-bot: Suggested immediate containment: 1) pause further unpin rollouts 2) target rollback to 3.7.2 for eu-west instances causing errors 3) flag incident if >1% for 30m. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/runtime-rollback

tim: should we do a soft-rollback (slice) instead of full region? I'd prefer to target only instances that are hitting the error bucket to avoid flapping.

jun: agree. We can use deploybot to roll back by tag: `deploybot rollback runtime 3.7.2 --filter 'label:hit-token-error' --region eu-west` The filter will match telemetry-tagged hosts.

deploy-bot: Action available: `deploybot rollback runtime 3.7.2 --region eu-west --dry-run`

rachel: dry-run shows 18 matching hosts. If we roll back on those, error rate in eu-west should drop under 0.2% per earlier similarity tests.

alice: do it. Also open a short postmortem stub and a customer-facing note if this hits >1% for any paying customer.

alice: `deploybot rollback runtime 3.7.2 --region eu-west --filter 'label:hit-token-error'` -> executing

deploy-bot: Action queued: rollback runtime to 3.7.2 on 18 filtered hosts in eu-west. ETA ~40s.

deploy-bot: Action complete: 18 hosts rolled back. Instances now reporting runtime=3.7.2: 18/18.

jun: telemetry after ~12m: eu-west error rate dropped from 0.8% -> 0.12% overall. Pinned hosts show 0.05%.

ops-bot: Auto-alert threshold still at 0.5% for 30m. Current eu-west aggregate: 0.18%. No incident escalation needed yet.

alice: good work. Next steps: 1) hold main unpin rollout globally 2) add a regression test in runtime-ci for quantized long-seq paths 3) patch release 3.8.1 to fix length calc in optimized quant code.

rachel: I'll draft the 3.8.1 changelog and include affected models: llama-q-v3b, llama-q-v4a; note customer-facing mitigation: targeted rollback performed in eu-west.

jun: I'll push a minimal repro and a unit test in runtime repo (will link PR). Also will add a guard to telemetry to mark hosts that saw out-of-range exceptions for easier future slices.

tim: ops: can we schedule a maintenance window tonight 00:30-02:00 UTC to roll 3.8.1 to staging and run a canary? Prefer to get the fix out quickly.

ops-bot: Maintenance window available: 00:30-02:00 UTC. Recommend canary to ap-south first, then eu-west.

alice: approved. I'll pause the global unpin and add a note on the release tracking thread.

rachel: customer notification draft: "We paused a runtime rollout after observing tokenizer parity issues affecting quantized models in specific region (eu-west). We performed a targeted rollback for impacted hosts; a patch release (3.8.1) is planned and will be canaried during the maintenance window."

alice: final: keep this thread active. update if metric crosses threshold or if PR merges. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
